name: get_camera_position_y

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetCameraPositionY increments Script stackTop and pushes the integer-converted Y component of the reconstructed camera position

notes: func_001C7FE0 snapshots the live camera position D_002DECE0 and target D_002DECF0, derives their distance and orientation in the shared camera-parameter state, and func_001EB148 reconstructs the position from that target, orientation, and distance. ScriptCommand_GetCameraPositionY converts the reconstructed Y component to an integer and pushes it. Commands 311 and 313 are identical coordinate getters for X and Z. The JP corpus contains eight calls in pc01.ard: four resource variants repeat the same two call sites, immediately store the result in local 1, and compare it with 1400 or 400 to select height-dependent behavior.
